messages:
Alex: FYI noticed a p99 spike on the latency dashboard for service=api-realtime after yesterday's routing policy tweak. p50/p95 unchanged, p99 up ~35%. Endpoint-level breakdown points to /v1/stream only. Anyone else seeing this?
Maria: Which Console view/filters did you use? Endpoints > Percentiles or the older endpoint page? Can you paste the exact filter? :mag_right:
Alex: Console -> Observability -> Latency -> Endpoints, filters: region=us-east, model=redwood-13b, endpoint=/v1/stream. Link: https://console/redwood/latency?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fstream
Dan: My hunch: fallback to legacy pool after the routing weight change. If a tiny fraction is hitting pool:reserved-legacy (higher tail), p99 can jump while median stays steady.
Olivia: infra logs show quota_exceeded around 03:12 UTC that triggered fallbacks for tenant=acme-co. Snippet:
```
{"time":"2026-02-18T03:12:08Z","tenant":"acme-co","route":"api-realtime","decision":"fallback","reason":"quota_exceeded","target":"pool:reserved-legacy"}
```
Jeff: Critical question for Console: are percentiles computed by merging tdigests from shards or by naively merging per-origin percentiles? The latter underestimates tails.
Maria: Backend merges tdigests then computes pctl, so math is correct. UX collapses sample_origin by default though, so the UI hides that the tail originated from the legacy pool. Users interpret p99 as a single-service regression.
Alex: So not a math bug, but a misleading presentation. We should surface origin context and counts.
Dan: Also sampling fractions vary. Some routes sample 1/20; if legacy pool had higher sample fraction temporarily, that can amplify observed p99. We need sample_count with percentiles.
Jeff: Proposals: 1) immediate: surface sample_count and top sample_origin badges in the percentile hover; 2) mid-term: add one-click drilldown partitioned by sample_origin and a short tooltip explaining that percentiles come from merged tdigests.
Olivia: I can ship a small PR adding sample_count and an origin-drill link in the tooltip. ETA today EOD for the UI patch.
infra-bot: route-policy-service v2.4 deployed by @deploy-bot at 2026-02-18T02:58:43Z (sha: b7a9c3e) :rocket:
Maria: Can we also show a tiny warning icon when sample_count < 50 for the selected window? Low counts can make p99 noisy.
Olivia: Good idea. I'll add a low-sample warning threshold and include it in the PR.
Alex: Plan: Olivia lands tooltip+drilldown+low-sample warning; Dan to verify sampling fractions and raw samples for 03:10-03:20 UTC; Jeff to draft Console FAQ blurb about merge semantics and best debugging flow. I'll notify oncall and CS if customers escalate. :thumbsup:
Jeff: Will draft the blurb, DM me when PR is in.
Maria: Filing a brief dashboard incident note for CS with root-cause (routing -> quota fallback -> legacy pool tail) and mitigation (surface origins + adjust routing weights).
Alex: Closing after PR merges and we confirm tail reduces post-weight-adjust. Thanks team. :wave:
